newsitem.title: USA: Noble files shelf for $575 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Noble files shelf for $575 mln in debt.

text.p: Noble Affiliates Inc said Friday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $575 million in debt securities.
The securities may be issued as senior debt securities or subordinated debt securities, the company said in the filing.

Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, which may include refinancing of indebtedness, working capital, capital expenditures, acquisitions and repurchases and redemption of securities, the company said.
Noble, of Ardmore, Okla., is an independent energy company engaged in the exploration, production and marketing of crude oil and natural gas.
